quote: There is no universal countable pentagon-free graph
note: The universality problem for C-free graphs was formulated by Cherlin and Komjáth in their 1994 paper. Earlier foundational work on universal graphs with forbidden structures began with Henson (1971), but the formal problem asking for which finite sets C of graphs the class of C-free countable graphs has a universal member under strong embeddings was posed in 1994.
